authority_ceiling: ARM-07 sole technical owner of qwen27-mtp per HEAD07 R2; all mutations under the flock measurement-window protocol; profile promotion requires Head ruling

claims.text: VERDICT: REJECT under the ruling's gates as written. The sole failing gate is deterministic-digest identity: the temp-0 seed-fixed qualify output under 5b (c5ff09be..., stable across all 5b runs) differs from the in-window baseline digest (35280d79...). Every other gate passes. Baseline was restored and verified after every window; production ends on the canonical K6/FP8/YaRN baseline.

Performance gates all PASS with wide margins, one uncontaminated in-window matrix, identical prompts/harness both sides: repeated-50k-prefix TTFT 10.014s -> 0.812s (12.33x, gate >=5x); repeated ~300k beyond-native TTFT 218.566s -> 4.384s (49.86x, gate >=3x); short-prompt decode +2.05% (gate allows -5%); cold-prefix penalties 1.3-4.7% (ungated per ruling).

Semantic gates other than digest PASS on 5b: thinking-true battery 18/18 (10/10 rigid-contract + 8/8 24k-extraction); beyond-native needle retrieved exactly with clean negative control using the foundry's baseline-proven probe run verbatim (depth 296,833 > native 262,144; negative answered NONE in 59s vs 268s on baseline — prefix reuse accelerating even the divergent case).

Stability and resource gates PASS: three controlled kill/recovery cycles on 5b, all automatic (88/86/84s to first correct completion), no EngineCore assertions, no CUDA/host OOM, no swap; 136 GB DDR5 pinned CPU pool, 17.7 GB physically offloaded GPU->CPU during the matrix, GPU KV pool 1,556,357 tokens at 1M under 5b.

OPERATIONAL FINDING (profile-independent): decode at ~300k context depth runs at 4.98 tok/s on baseline and 4.6-4.7 tok/s on 5b — a ~26x slowdown vs short context that is stack physics, not a candidate property. Any 1M-context workload on this box decodes at ~5 tok/s regardless of configuration; thinking-mode responses at depth take minutes to tens of minutes.

Instrument-failure history, stated plainly: (a) run 1 aborted a healthy 5b boot on a log-readback contaminated by vLLM-logged prompt text carrying old init lines — fixed by offset-anchored boot-segment parsing; (b) needle attempts 1-3 with a word-salad haystack were instrument-bound (thinking-mode reasoning consumed every budget; even the trivial negative control burned 2000 tokens) — settled by running the foundry probe verbatim; (c) needle window 1 crashed client-side and its restore was not in a finally block, leaving production on 5b with the lock released for ~4 minutes until this arm's emergency restore under a fresh lock — a self-caught protocol breach, receipted, and the harness now restores in try/finally.

decisions_requested.decision: Head 07: the sole failing gate is digest identity, and the output difference is deterministic and stable within-profile while every correctness measure passes (18/18 battery, beyond-native needle + clean negative, V-style behavior). Rule whether the digest gate should be re-scoped (e.g. to the V11 teacher-forced-NLL tolerance form) for retaining 5b as the opt-in qwen27-mtp-longprefix profile. Until ruled, REJECT stands and production remains on the canonical baseline.

Head 07: the ~5 tok/s decode-at-depth finding (C5) materially changes the operational value of 1M context on this stack; recommend it be weighed in any long-context product commitment. Optimizing it would be a NEW goal (per the stop-after-this-matrix rule) — flagging, not proposing scope.

risks: The digest difference has an unknown root mechanism (mamba-align state handling under reuse is the suspect); if 5b is ever retained, a recurrent-state equivalence test (as the FlashKDA ruling demanded for kernel substitutions) would be the rigorous closure.
The protocol breach in C6 was recovered in ~4 minutes but real; the try/finally fix is in place, and window wrappers should gain a supervising restore-check before any future mutation window.
